_note: A heuristic, not a translation: common English report words and the Arabic DataArcus proposes for them (modern, simple Standard Arabic), used only to PROPOSE display names and twin labels that the user approves. A name with any word not listed gets no proposal; the user gives its Arabic. English sources only. Shared by the MCP (mcp/lib/arabic-names.mjs) and, later, the website.
_phrases: The report's own fixed texts (page names, buttons, the empty state, tooltip pages), each whole, with the Arabic the report writer itself writes for them (assets/js/design-engine.js, pbip-page.js): the Arabic twin drafts them from here (mcp/lib/arabic-names.mjs draftText; 0.3.0 D3). mcp/test-0.3.0-twin-complete.mjs checks each against the writer.
